comments.body:
According to OGPlanet Screenshot for 120 Premium Bottle Event:
235 Vertical Sails 367 Horizontal Sails 15 Turn 11 WR 32 Armour
819 Dura 1/6 Improve (Armour D. B. / Random Improvement)
32/147 Sailors 0/84 Cannon 323 Cargo
165 Ship Prof

Despite Having 1 improvement, why is there a huge difference in sailors and cannon slots ? Is it due to the random improvement ?

Is it advisable to change the material to country plating ?

comments.author: Erda
comments.body: a trick to get it hotter imo ... 147 is explainable , its the max crew . however i can only guess that the driver uses 4 cannons/carro16 and 2x10 bow/stern cannon , the cargo actually do support my guessing

comments.author: tare
comments.body: This ship has potentially more crew than a augmented research frigate (guessing) but has only 4 broadside slots whereas the augmented research frigate has 5. Would this ship be better than the augmented research frigate if the goal is to be used as an adventure ship with capabilities of withstanding assaults to a certain degree and quickly escaping ?

comments.author: Beatrice
comments.body: why not , it does have EA though , and with stern turret , no pirate would attack u unless he wants to be dead well if u have r10 battle skills i guess , and i do believe there is a something +1 gunport right ?

comments.body: +1 gunport ? Is that an improvement skill for the ship ?

comments.author: Miles
comments.body: +1 gunport via fusion

comments.author: tare
comments.body: Can this ship (heavy shize) be fused with another ship of different class (small or standard ship sizes) and inherit their skills like an Escort Corvette with Evade Melee Battle or something ?

comments.author: Ayria
comments.body: Yes it can, but you need to note, skill inheritance works for all skills EXCEPT 3, they are: Evade Melee Battle, Direct Hit Prevention and Rowing Assistance.
